bio: Research contributor to adaptive-optics test benches and astronomical instrumentation, including MATTO and SOXS.
long_bio: Federico contributes to optical-instrument assembly, integration and verification, including SOXS at the New Technology Telescope. He has co-authored work on integrating and verifying the SOXS Common Path and participates in the wider MATTO laboratory collaboration. His research connects practical optomechanical testing with the commissioning of astronomical instruments.
